post.description: Authenticate using the apikey and the secretKey. The response returns a JSON Web Token (JWT), which must be used for authentication against other API calls in subsequent requests.

requestBody.description: JSON payload containing API credentials required for authentication.

schema.description: Request schema for authenticating with API credentials.

PApiLoginRequest.description: Request payload for authenticating with API credentials.
PApiLoginRequest.title: PApiLoginRequest

apiKey.description:
API key ID obtained from credential management.

Note: Keep this value secure and never expose it in front-end code or public repositories.

secretKey.description:
Client secret paired with the API key.

Note: This is a sensitive credential. Store it securely (e.g., in environment variables, secure vaults, or secret management systems). Never expose in logs, front-end code, or version control systems.

PApiLoginResponse.description: Response payload containing JWT token and authentication status message.
PApiLoginResponse.title: PApiLoginResponse

jwtToken.description:
JSON Web Token (JWT) for authenticating subsequent API requests.

Note: This token has an expiration time. Call the login endpoint again to obtain a new token when it expires.

message.description: API login status, describing the authentication result.
